caveats: restaurants_naics722 uses the SELF-REPORTED NAICS on the business registration and spans all of 722 (full-service 722511, limited-service 722513, snack/coffee 722515, food-service contractors 722310, caterers 722320, mobile food 722330, bars 722410). Financial District/South Beach is inflated by caterers/contractors registered at office addresses. 2.7% of 722 rows lack coordinates; those with a neighborhood field were still assigned, the rest count only in 'City of SF'.

The registry marks a location active only when TTX has been told it closed; closures lag, so NAICS counts overstate operating restaurants. A stricter cross-check (locations carrying a DPH RESTAURANT/TAKE-OUT/FAST FOOD health-permit LIC code) gives 3,816 citywide vs 5,364 NAICS-722; per-zone LIC counts are in the notes column.

restaurants_dph counts distinct DPH permits inspected since 2024-01-02 with a RESTAURANT/TAKE-OUT/FAST FOOD permit type; facilities not inspected in that window are missing, and bars, bakeries, food trucks, caterers and markets with food prep are excluded (broader 'food-service' count = 5,755 citywide, per-zone in notes).

Population is ACS 2023 5-year (2019-2023 average) allocated by whole tract via tract internal point, so neighborhood/radius populations are approximate where tracts straddle boundaries; three zero-population water/island tracts were snapped to the nearest polygon. Tract sums total 836,321.

Radius rows use only San Francisco data (restaurants, tracts, land); the 3- and 5-mile circles cover bay water and, at 5 miles, reach beyond the county line, so their full geometric areas (28.3 and 78.5 sqmi) are not the denominators used. Neighborhood polygons include some pier/shoreline fill, so areas can differ slightly from other published figures.
Zero-vehicle share is households with no vehicle available (B08201) over all households, aggregated across the tracts assigned to each zone.
failed_steps: p5b7-5n3h (Analysis Neighborhoods) .geojson and geospatial export endpoints returned features with null geometry/empty rows (dataset appears to be a tabular view now); used the identical 41-polygon computed-region dataset ajp5-b2md instead.
api.census.gov ACS endpoint returned a 'Missing Key' HTML page (an API key is now required for tract queries); fell back to the ACS 2023 5-year table-based summary files (.dat) for B01003 and B08201.

g8m3-pdis does not expose naic_code / naic_code_description / business_end_date as described; the live schema has self_reported_naics_code (no description, no ranges like '7220-7229') and location_end_date, which were used instead. The administratively_closed flag was null for every active food-service row.

DPH tvy3-wexg has 10 grouped rows with null permit_number (deduped on dba+address instead) and 15 restaurant permits without coordinates (assigned via analysis_neighborhood; excluded from radius rows).
